### Grounding highlights (verbatim)
- `tldraw/packages/store/src/lib/Store.ts:1110-1113` — `createCache(...)` builds `new WeakCache<Atom<any>, Signal<Result>>()`; `:1131-1141` `createComputedCache` layers per-id `computed` on it; `:1436-1455` the module-level `createComputedCache` holds `new WeakCache<Context, ComputedCache<...>>()`. Entry lifetime is tied to the *atom/context*, never to the record id it is read by (`:1447` `get(context, id)`).
- `table/packages/table-core/src/utils/getCoreRowModel.ts:53` — `rowModel.rowsById[row.id] = row`: a second row with an equal `getRowId` result silently overwrites the first. Same pattern at `filterRowsUtils.ts:49,56,64,118` and `getGroupedRowModel.ts:46,131,152`.
- `table/packages/table-core/src/types.ts:224-228` — `RowModel.rowsById: Record<string, Row<TData>>` is the contract that assumes key equality means subject identity.
- `table/packages/table-core/src/features/RowExpanding.ts:264,299` and `RowSelection.ts:595-628` — expansion/selection carried on row ids with no prune step when the row leaves the model.
- `shakedown` (tldraw, `packages/editor/src`, uncapped, 14 hits / 5 files) — the per-shape caches at `Editor.ts:982,5320,5336,5391,5445,5475,5512,5579,6687`, `SnapManager/HandleSnaps.ts:62`, `SnapManager/BoundsSnaps.ts:207`, `FontManager/FontManager.ts:37`, `overlays/strokeShapeIndicators.ts:1,5`.
